name: Aly Cook
why: I am sick of seeing money wasted on bureaucracy that is bloated and endless consultants. I want to see New Zealand move toward a direct democracy, where people get the say and governments' jobs are to carry out the will of the people. I also in the first instance will be looking for accountability on decisions made by government & using Parliamentary privilege to call out lies where I see them.

name: Bruce Dooley
why: As a medical doctor I am concerned about the serious decline in quality and delivery of New Zealand's once-excellent health system. Additionally, we need to address diet and exercise with a mind towards prevention. When in Parliament I intend to work hard to focus government attention on our medical and health crisis.

name: Daymond Goulder-Horobin
why: I am running to restore sanity and balance to our Parliament and Government. Our Government is currently rife with insanity, and many are out of touch with the real world. I will prove to the world that we can indeed have a Government that can be relied upon and trusted by the people to protect them from foreign adversaries and the uncertainty of new technology that poses new challenges for our Nation.

why: I believe that we have so many broken systems from councils, health, education, Police and the judicial system. There needs to be some accountability. Someone asking the hard questions all the time, not just at election time or at point Break, or when it's safe to jump on board after someone else has tested the waters.
